description: Source code implementing ELF memory image parsing and symbol lookup for debugging purposes within the Abseil library.

classes.name: ElfMemImage
classes.description: Class representing an in-memory ELF image for symbol lookup and analysis.

classes.name: ElfMemImage::SymbolIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing symbols within an ELF image.

methods.description: Returns the number of symbols in the ELF image.

methods.description: Retrieves a dynamic symbol by index.

methods.name: GetVersym

methods.name: GetPhdr
methods.description: Retrieves a program header by index.

methods.name: GetDynstr
methods.description: Retrieves a dynamic string at a given offset.

methods.name: GetSymAddr
methods.description: Gets the address of a symbol.

methods.name: GetVerdef
methods.description: Gets version definition info by index.

methods.name: LookupSymbol
